english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a salad dish, including salad used as a sandwich filling; use 沙律菜 when you specifically mean the raw greens or vegetables.

examples.english: I want a chicken salad sandwich.
examples.traditional: 我想要個雞肉沙律三文治。
